newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SOCCER-CZECH GOVERNMENT BACKING JOINT EURO-BID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CZECH GOVERNMENT BACKING JOINT EURO-BID.

text.p: The Czech government said on Wednesday it would support a joint Czech-Austrian bid to host the European football championship finals in 2004.

Czech Sports and Education Minister Ivan Pilip told journalists the government would give guarantees on the organisation of the bid, and, if successful, help with the construction of the necessary infrastructure.
"We expect that during a visit to Austria next Monday, this plan will be confirmed, and we will try to support it so the Czech Republic is chosen," Pilip said.
Czech venues would include Prague, Ostrava and Brno, and either Plzen or Teplice.
